entities.name: Louise Fréchette
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louise Fréchette is a Canadian diplomat and public servant who served for eight years as United Nations Deputy Secretary-General. She also served a three-year term at the Centre for International Governance Innovation, an international relations and policy think-tank in Waterloo, Ontario, working on a major research project on nuclear energy and the world's security.

entities.summary: Louise Fréchette is a Canadian diplomat and public servant who served for eight years as United Nations Deputy Secretary-General.
